mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, phone, gender, avatar, email, status, dept_id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.password, u.status, u.dept_id, u.tenant_id, u.last_password_change_time, r.code AS role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON u.id = sur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON sur.role_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = 0
